mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(MAX(revision),0) FROM expression_basis_review WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND item_id=#{itemId}
SELECT FROM expression_basis_review WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND item_id=#{itemId} AND version_id=#{versionId} ORDER BY revision DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT ordinal,fact_item_id AS item_id,fact_version_id AS version_id,title,version_number, project_id,source_generation,project_generation FROM expression_basis_review_fact WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND review_id=#{reviewId} ORDER BY ordinal LIMIT 51
